title: Kth Largest Element
problem: Find the kth largest value using a min-heap of size k.
learner_message: When the heap already has k items, do we remove the smallest whenever a bigger number comes in?
teacher_message:
Visual:
Top k values, in descending order:
[largest ... | kth largest]
              ↑ target rank k

Yes. Once there are k candidates, the smallest of those k is the cutoff. If the next value is larger than that cutoff, remove the cutoff and include the new value; otherwise, keep the candidates unchanged. This keeps the requested value at descending rank k.

model_diagnosis.decomposition: Asks about heap maintenance without stating the descending-rank meaning of k.

model_assessment.rationale: The question concerns removing the smallest item but does not identify the requested value as the one with descending rank k.

title: Kth Largest Element
problem: Find the kth largest value using a min-heap of size k.
learner_message: So if the next value is smaller, I should still pop the heap to make room for it?
teacher_message:
Visual:
Descending top-k candidates:
[largest ... | kth largest]
                    ↑ cutoff at rank k

No. If the next value is smaller than the cutoff, keep the k candidates unchanged. Remove the cutoff only when the next value is larger, so the cutoff remains the value at descending rank k.

model_diagnosis.decomposition: The learner is checking a heap-action condition without identifying the requested descending rank.

model_assessment.rationale: The message asks a procedural question but does not demonstrate recognition of the kth-largest rank.

title: Kth Largest Element
problem: Find the kth largest value using a min-heap of size k.
learner_message: Okay, so I only replace the smallest when the new number is bigger; otherwise I leave the heap alone.
teacher_message:
Visual:
nums ordered from largest to smallest:
[largest ... | value at descending position k]
                         ↑ requested result

Right: replace the smallest candidate only when the new number is bigger. The key idea is that the answer is the value at descending rank k among nums. In one short phrase, what does “kth largest” mean?

model_diagnosis.decomposition: The message states when to replace the heap minimum, but does not identify the target as the value at descending rank k.

model_assessment.rationale: The message describes the replacement condition but does not demonstrate recognition of the kth-largest rank.

title: Kth Largest Element
problem: Find the kth largest value using a min-heap of size k.
learner_message: It means the number that has exactly k−1 numbers larger than it.
teacher_message:
Visual:
nums ordered from largest to smallest:
[1st ... | kth]
             ↑ requested value at descending rank k

Exactly: the kth-largest value is the one with k−1 values in nums larger than it.

model_diagnosis.decomposition: Identifies the kth-largest value by its descending rank.

model_assessment.evidence_quote: It means the number that has exactly k−1 numbers larger than it.
model_assessment.rationale: The learner correctly states the defining rank relationship for the kth-largest value.
